Description:
MAC address
Each byte corresponds to two hexadecimal digits.

SHA value of controller firmware
Only the first 4 bytes are used.
E.g., when the bytes stream in 00 11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88 99 AA BB CC DD EE FF, the 
SHA value of controller firmware will be 00112233

Motor corretion flag
0 — Motor correction not finished
1 — Motor correction finished

Encoder disk correction flag
0——Encoder disk correction not finished
1——Encoder disk correction finished
Destination IP address of point cloud data packets
Destination UDP port of point could data packets

Destination UDP port of GPS data packets
Valid only when the "Clock Source" is "GPS"

Status of sync angle (phase lock)
0 - Disable  1 - Enable

UDP sequence number
0 – UDP sequence OFF
1 – UDP sequence ON(default)

Motor type~status
0x0*—cannot reverse the rotation direction
0x1*—supports reversing the rotation direction
0x*0—currently rotating clockwise
0x*1—currently rotating counterclockwise

Flag for VLAN tagging
0—VLAN Not in use
1—VLAN In use

PTP status
0 — free run
1 — tracking
2 — locked
3 — frozen

PTP 协议配置使用状态
0 — Disable  1 — Enable

IEEE timing and synchronization standard
2 — 802.1AS Automotive
3 — 802.1AS AUTOSAR
Domain attribute of the local clock
This item is used to specify the command to be used for the lidar upgrade
